Gems usually disappear after use, but like most consumable items, they’re returned to you after important battles, such as battles against Gym Leaders. "When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves
immediately after evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Link Stones[blue]."

"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to
fill his Gym with a dense fog.

Usually, this makes it harder for
attacks to land.

But if you bring a Pokémon
with the abilities [green]Keen Eye[blue] or\l[green]Infiltrator[blue], its attacks will\lland no problem.

[green]Pikipek[blue] and [green]Hoothoot[blue] on [green]Route 2[blue] can
be caught with Keen Eye, so why\ldon’t you head over there and nab\lyourself one of them?"

"Pokémon with the abilities [green]Keen
Eye[blue] and [green]Infiltrator[blue] can easily land\ltheir attacks in foggy weather.

I don’t think that can happen
anywhere outside of Borrius!"

Abilities like [green]Stench[blue] can also\lhelp keep wild Pokémon away."

"You should try to beat as many
Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you the more Badges you have."

"Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take
a well-earned breather for the\ltime being.

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 you’re taking on
the Gym challenge, right?

In that case, you should probably
check out [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue].

It’s not exactly an official Gym,
but think of it like Gym 4.5!

I heard that if you can defeat
the Successor of the Mansion,\lyou’ll be able to wield an\lincredible new power!

What kind? Ha ha, that would be
spoiling the surprise!"

"But, let’s not take too long of
a break.

We can’t forget the Shadows are still
out there, and they still have\lMoltres and Articuno.

Luckily, I finished talking with
Grampa, and I think I might know\lhow to get them back.

Once you’re finished with
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue], head [green]north[blue]\ltowards [green]Route 12[blue].

I’ll meet up with you in
[green]Dehara City[blue].

We can go over the plan to
rescue them from the Shadows\lonce you arrive.

Alright, see you then!"

"Welcome to the Mission HQ!

This is your first time here,
isn’t it?

Then, tell me, do you know
about [green]Missions[blue]?"

"I see\.

Well, then in that case, allow me
to give a formal explanation."

"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request\lfor help.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Mission Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered\lin your Mission Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need\lof assistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."

entries.original:
"[player], my [buffer1], a hearty
congratulations to you!

I heard the news!

To think, after all this time, I
have finally bested old Arthur!

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. excuse me.

Now, my [buffer1], the reason for
my visit.

I have yet another errand for
you to run!

You thought you were done with
those, didn’t you?

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. anyway, following your
defeat of Hoopa atop Crystal Peak,\lmysterious portals have begun\lappearing around Borrius.

When approached, powerful Pokémon
are said to leap forth.

As the Guardian of Borrius in both
name and standing, it is your\lresponsibility to take care of\lthese Pokémon.

I assume that in most cases, if you
capture the Pokémon, the portals\lwill disappear permanently.

Although, it is doubtful that they
will all stay gone forever\.

In any case!

Capture the Pokémon found in these
mysterious portals.

Some portals may only appear if you
bring specific Pokémon, but the\lPokémon in those portals must be\lcaptured regardless.

And if a portal refuses to disappear
permanently after catching the\lPokémon, simply registering it in\lyour Pokédex will be enough."

job I’d love.

But work requires effort, so I
became a Gambler.

Sometimes, I win and make money;
other times, I become indebted to\lthe Black Ferrothorn.

I want to quit, but I’m the best,
and I can’t quit while I’m number\lone.

Can you out pop me in balloons?"

"Howdy there, partner.

likin’ and all.

else around ya can keep yer\leyes on\.

battlin’ me fer fun.

That’s none o’ my beeswax.

But as Gym Leader, I can’t just up
and fork over a Badge to any ol’\lcowpoke.

So, let’s just get this on.

Let this handsome fella test
yer mettle!"
